facts.activity_file: setting, testing and sealing pressure relief devices

assets.label: pressure relief devices
assets.service: overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices
controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: unplanned release of chemical energy at PSV-4111

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices on PSV-4111 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically setting, testing and sealing pressure relief devices. PSV-4111 (pressure relief devices) is in service for overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system. The task proceeded during routine operation while the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices had degraded below its design intent. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 25 September 2012 a hazard report was recorded on PSV-4111 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during routine operation; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
